newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Tuesday it raised the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$4.00/cubic metre or C$0.64/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:

Edmonton light sweet C$171.00/cubic metre, or C$27.19/barrel Cromer light sour C$163.00/cubic metre, or C$25.91/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$135.00/cubic metre, or C$21.46/barrel Midale at Cromer C$149.00/cubic metre, or C$23.69/barrel
